title: MVS-XAI: Multi-View Stacking with Explainable AI for Financial Fraud Detection
summary: A research framework for digital financial transaction fraud detection combining multi-view stacking (tabular, sequential, behavioral views with six base models), a meta-learner ensemble, and a five-level explainable AI audit pipeline evaluated on IEEE-CIS and PaySim datasets. Its data_sampler.py optionally imports sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer and sdv.metadata.SingleTableMetadata to synthesize minority-class fraud transactions for data augmentation when SDV is installed.
evidence: src/data_pipeline/data_sampler.py:25-130 imports CTGANSynthesizer/SingleTableMetadata from sdv, raises ImportError if sdv missing, then runs 'CTGAN Synthesis' on fraud_data
